text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Magistrates heading provincial commissions in charge of monitoring local council elections take up their posts.
- Morocco and France seek cooperation between their respective public administration schools.
- Seventeen Moroccans seeking to emigrate illegally landed in the North Moroccan city of Tangier after their middleman pretended they had arrived in Spain.
- Moroccan-Spanish commission paves the way for better transiting conditions for expatriates returning home for summer.
- Head of the agency for the development of northern provinces asks the Netherlands to gather support of the European Union for implementation of projects in the region.
- Staff at state-owned farmers fund Caisse Nationale du Credit Agricole (CNCA) to go on two day strike on June 4.
